title: Figure 11. Electrothermal Arcjet Thruster on Lockheed Martin Series 7000 Comsat
description: Composite figure pairing an illustration of a communications satellite in orbit with a photograph of the gold-foil-wrapped satellite in a cleanroom, with a yellow circle and arrow highlighting the thruster location and an inset photo of a firing arcjet. Captioned "Figure 11. Electrothermal Arcjet Thruster on Satellite. Lockheed Martin Series 7000 Comsat with Aerojet 1.8-kW Arcjet thrusters (insert photo) for north-south station keeping." Appears at the start of "Chapter 3: Space Applications."
